cards.interpretation: FIXTURE. Under Second Fixture Classifier first edition, GENEA mutation defines Fixture Entity One, recorded here as AML, at any blast count; no blast threshold applies. The source does not state an exclusion.

FIXTURE. GENEA mutation is a validated fixture follow-up marker and should be tracked with a high-sensitivity assay. The source does not state the assay threshold or the timepoints at which it applies.
